methods.label: Add all four reported values
methods.explanation:
Adding the four reported values helps because every original integer contributes equally to that sum. Each integer appears once as the fourth integer and three times inside an average, contributing one third each time. Thus each original integer is counted twice.

Let \(S\) be the sum of the four original integers. Then
\[
2S=29+23+21+17=90,
\]
so \(S=45\).

If \(x\) is the fourth integer and \(v\) is its reported result, the other three integers have sum \(45-x\). Therefore
\[
v=x+\frac{45-x}{3}=\frac{45+2x}{3},
\qquad x=\frac{3v-45}{2}.
\]
Using \(v=29,23,21,17\) gives the original integers \(21,12,9,3\), respectively. They are positive integers with sum \(45\), and the displayed formula verifies all four reported results. One original integer is therefore \(\boxed{21}\), choice B.
